Complete [[Vizunah Square]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Locate and destroy the source of the plague in [[Kaineng City]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 25 minutes. {{sic|see the Notes section}}
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Vizunah Square#walkthrough|Vizunah Square]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"Plague is spreading throughout [[Cantha]]. [[Master Togo]] and Brother [[Mhenlo]] can't do it alone. Join them in [[Kaineng City]] - together you must discover the source and survive long enough to end the sickness."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Similar to the mission, completing in under 35 minutes when doing this quest in [[Hard mode]] will still gain you the first bonus objective.
